card.name: Final pieces of brand and species names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a longer capitalized name, such as a brand drug name or a Latin or common animal or plant name, usually just before the name is complete. It also fires on a few words like 'the' or 'tree' that follow a noun phrase.

modes.label: Brand drug names
modes.description: Closing piece of an invented brand name in dosing or indications text.
modes.example: The recommended dosage of TAZVER<<IK>> is 800 mg orally twice

modes.label: Species and organism names

modes.example: Hidden Diversity Behind the Zombie-Ant Fung<<us>> Ophiocordyceps unilateral
